tagline: Do connections: ek baat karne ke liye, ek file ke liye.
description: FTP files move karne ke sabse purane internet protocols mein se ek hai. Commands aur numbered replies port 21 ke control connection par jaate hain, aur har file apne alag data connection par jaati hai. Plain FTP sab kuch, passwords samet, clear text mein bhejta hai.
facts: Koi nahi; FTPS (RFC 4217) ya SFTP use karo

normal.name: Passive mode mein file download karo
normal.summary: Port 21 par login karo, binary par switch karo, PASV karo, aur doosre connection par report.pdf fetch karo.

steps.title: 21 par control connection
steps.desc: Sirf commands ke liye ek TCP connection
steps.detail: FTP do tarah ke connections use karta hai. Port 21 ka control connection poore session ke liye text commands aur numbered replies le jaata hai. Files alag data connections par jaati hain. Handshake ke baad server 220 se greet karta hai.

steps.title: USER aur PASS
steps.desc: 331 password maangta hai, 230 login karata hai
steps.detail: Client USER danish bhejta hai; server 331 se jawab deta hai, jiska matlab hai "ab tak theek, password bhejo". Phir PASS correct-horse-42 plain text mein jaata hai aur server 230 Login successful se reply karta hai. Classic FTP mein encryption bilkul nahi hai, isliye ye password path par kisi ko bhi padhne ko mil jaata hai.

quiz.q: USER danish ke baad server 331 reply karta hai. Client se ab aage kya bhejne ki ummeed hai?
quiz.why: 3xx replies ka matlab "aur information chahiye". 331 khaas taur par password maangta hai.

steps.title: PWD aur TYPE I
steps.desc: Main kahan hoon, aur binary par switch
steps.detail: PWD working directory print karta hai: server 257 se path quotes mein deta hai. TYPE I image (binary) mode par switch karta hai taaki file byte-by-byte bheji jaye. Purane ASCII mode mein server line endings rewrite kar deta, jo PDFs aur images ko corrupt kar deta hai.
facts: Binary, bytes mein koi change nahi
ASCII, line endings rewrite karta hai

steps.title: PASV: kahan connect karna hai
steps.detail: PASV server se kehta hai ki naya port khole aur client ka wait kare. Reply address aur port ko chhe numbers mein pack karta hai: (h1,h2,h3,h4,p1,p2). Yahan wo 203.0.113.40 aur port 195 × 256 + 149 = 50069 hai. Kyunki client connection bahar ki taraf kholta hai, ye home routers aur NAT ke through chalta hai.

quiz.q: Reply (…,195,149) par khatam hota hai. Client ko kaun se port se connect karna chahiye?
quiz.why: Port p1 × 256 + p2 = 195 × 256 + 149 = 50069 hai. p1 high byte hai, p2 low byte.

steps.title: Data connection kholo
steps.detail: Client port 50112 se 203.0.113.40:50069 tak bilkul naya TCP connection kholta hai. Ye data connection hai. Abhi ispar kuch nahi bheja gaya: client ko control connection par batana abhi baaki hai ki use kaun si file chahiye.

steps.title: RETR aur file
steps.detail: Control connection par client RETR report.pdf bhejta hai. Server 150 se jawab deta hai aur file ko data connection par push karna shuru karta hai: yahan do poore 1460-byte segments. Khatam hone par wo data connection ko FIN se close kar deta hai. Connection ka end hi file ka end hai.

quiz.q: Client ko kaise pata chalta hai ki poori file aa gayi?
options: Server data connection close kar deta hai
quiz.why: FTP ke normal stream mode mein data connection ka FIN file ka end batata hai. Control par 226 reply ise confirm karta hai.

steps.title: 226 aur goodbye
steps.detail: Control connection par server 226 Transfer complete se confirm karta hai. Client ab aur files maang sakta tha, har ek apne PASV aur data connection ke saath. Uski jagah wo QUIT bhejta hai aur 221 Goodbye pata hai.

outro.title: File download ho gayi
outro.text: Control connection ne login aur commands carry kiye; port 50069 ke alag data connection ne file carry ki aur apna end batane ke liye close ho gaya. Ye chala, par password internet par plain text mein gaya.

active-nat.name: NAT ne active mode block kiya
active-nat.summary: PORT private address bhejta hai; server ke port 20 se SYNs kabhi pahunchte nahi.

steps.title: Client active mode maangta hai
steps.detail: Ek purana FTP client active mode use karta hai. PASV ki jagah wo apne address aur port ke saath PORT bhejta hai, PORT 192,168,1,10,195,200, matlab "mujhse 192.168.1.10 port 50120 par connect karo". Ye private home address hai, jiska internet par koi matlab nahi.

quiz.q: Active mode mein data connection kaun kholta hai?
options: Server, client ki taraf wapas connect karke
Koi nahi, data control connection use karta hai
quiz.why: Active mode direction ulta kar deta hai: server port 20 se PORT command ke address par connect karta hai.

steps.title: Server andar connect nahi kar sakta
steps.desc: Port 20 se SYNs kabhi nahi pahunchte
steps.detail: RETR ke baad server port 20 se 192.168.1.10 tak connect karne ki koshish karta hai. Ye address internet par route nahi ho sakta, aur agar Danish ke router tak pahunch bhi jaye, to router ka firewall un connection attempts ko drop kar deta hai jo andar kisi ne maange nahi. Server 1 aur 3 seconds baad retry karta hai.

steps.title: 425: data connection nahi bana
steps.detail: Server haar maan leta hai aur control connection par 425 report karta hai. Fix hai PASV (ya EPSV), jahan client data connection bahar ki taraf kholta hai, jo NAT aur firewalls allow karte hain. Modern clients default mein passive mode use karte hain.
facts: PASV / EPSV (client bahar connect karta hai)
Inbound sirf wahi jo maanga gaya ho

quiz.q: Home router ke peeche PORT fail hota hai to PASV kyun chalta hai?
options: PASV mein client data connection bahar ki taraf shuru karta hai, jo NAT allow karta hai
PASV data ke liye port 21 use karta hai
quiz.why: Home routers outgoing connections aur unke replies ko jaane dete hain, par unexpected incoming connections block karte hain.

outro.title: Passive mode use karo
outro.text: Active mode mein server ko client ke andar connect karna padta hai, jise home routers aur firewalls block karte hain. Passive mode ise ulta kar deta hai taaki client hamesha bahar ki taraf connect kare.
facts: Private IP + firewall inbound SYN drop karta hai

sniffed.name: Password sniff hua: FTPS aur SFTP kyun
sniffed.summary: Ek passive listener FTP login padh leta hai; TLS (FTPS) ya SSH (SFTP) use chhupa deta hai.

steps.title: Wire par password
steps.desc: Plain FTP sab kuch dikha deta hai
steps.detail: Jo koi Danish ka traffic dekh sakta hai (shared Wi-Fi, compromised router) wo port 21 par filter kiya hua capture chalata hai. USER aur PASS lines plain text hain, aur data connections par har file bhi. Cracking ki zaroorat nahi.

steps.title: Defence: FTPS
steps.detail: FTPS FTP mein TLS jodta hai. Client AUTH TLS bhejta hai, server 234 se reply karta hai, aur control connection par TLS handshake chalta hai. Uske baad USER aur PASS encrypted hain, aur PROT P data connections ko bhi protect karta hai. SFTP ek alag protocol hai jo port 22 par SSH ke andar ek connection mein chalta hai, aur usually simpler choice hai.
facts: PROT P data connections encrypt karta hai

quiz.q: SFTP ke baare mein kya sach hai?
options: Ye SSH par chalta hai, usually port 22 par, alag data connections ke bina
Ye ab bhi plain text hai
quiz.why: Naam ke bawajood SFTP FTP hai hi nahi. Ye SSH connection ke andar ka file protocol hai, isliye firewall setup aasaan hai.

steps.title: Chori karne ko kuch nahi bacha
steps.detail: TLS chalu hone ke baad login encrypted records ke andar jaata hai. Eavesdropper ko ab bhi dikhta hai ki Danish FTP server se baat kar raha hai, par password ya files nahi.
facts: Plain FTP poori tarah disable karo

outro.title: File transfers encrypt karo
outro.text: Plain FTP password aur files un sabko de deta hai jo path dekh sakte hain. FTPS FTP ko TLS mein wrap karta hai, aur SFTP use SSH ke andar ke file protocol se replace karta hai. Dono mein se koi bhi login aur data private rakhta hai.
facts: Sirf public, anonymous files ke liye

cheatsheet.title: Commands
items: Server client ke liye port kholta hai
